summary: Repair the existing pre-send observation visibility guard when an 8192-character first-view projection hides a fully persisted latest tool result even though the actual model budget can fit the raw observation. No new execution authority or retry path is introduced.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing LoopEngine final Provider pre-send observation guard, durable Session truth, request preflight and EvidenceReadTool
components.disposition: Before interpreting a bounded first-view as missing evidence, restore only the exact latest atomic tool group from the same durable Session when ingress, call signatures and receipt IDs match. Check physical budget and Provider preflight; if raw cannot fit, retain the existing owner/version/hydration/schema-qualified exact-ref path or fail closed. No tool re-execution or new semantic authority.

g1.necessity: A bounded first-view is a representation policy, not evidence that the model window cannot fit the original latest tool observation. The incident produced two false context_capacity_unavailable HOLDs despite a large physical context window.

g2.authority_owner: Existing LoopEngine pre-send guard, durable Session, EvidenceReadTool and request-envelope preflight
g2.non_duplication: No new evidence store, model semantic judge, automatic tool retry, or separate capacity authority. The patch reuses the current Session raw group and the already-qualified exact-ref fallback.

model_evidence: exact current-run ingress identity and latest complete assistant/tool group
call IDs, function names and arguments and complete tool-result contents
physical projected-character budget and Provider hard-overflow preflight
owner-scoped EvidenceReadTool authorization, source version/freshness and blob SHA when exact-ref is required
g3.recovery_or_reason: Send the original tool observation only when exact pairing and capacity preflight pass. Otherwise send a qualified bounded exact-ref capsule, or HOLD without Provider send or tool replay. The model remains responsible for semantic interpretation.

g4.rollback: Revert the isolated change under managed release/rollback while keeping observation safety and original evidence durable; no silent disabling of the guard.
